title: Headcount planning grid
prompt: Finance plans headcount for every department at every job level, even levels a department doesn't have yet. Write `solve(departments)` so it returns one row for each department and each level from 1 to 5.
rules: Levels are 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Every department gets all five, so the result has five rows per department.
`level` is a whole number of type int, like `level` in `employees`.
Return only `department_id`, `department_name` and `level`, in that order.
hints: Every department with every level, with no condition, is a cross join.
Pick the two department columns first, then `crossJoin` the levels.
